# Real Estate FastPass

> A Daniel Larson School. Real Estate FastPass is the online home of Daniel Larson Training, a Florida real estate school offering self-paced licensing, exam preparation, Post-Licensing, and continuing education.

Primary website: https://realestatefastpass.com/
School: Daniel Larson Training, Florida real estate school license ZH1002860.
Instructor: Daniel Larson, Florida real estate instructor license ZH1003217.
Contact: daniel@daniellarsontraining.com; 239.471.8500.

## Courses and enrollment information

- [Sales licensing](https://realestatefastpass.com/): Course 1, Sales FastPass, and FastPass with Sales Post-Licensing.
- [Broker licensing](https://realestatefastpass.com/broker-licensing/): Course 2, Broker FastPass, and FastPass with Broker Post-Licensing.
- [Post-Licensing](https://realestatefastpass.com/post-licensing/): 45-hour Sales Post and 60-hour Broker Post, each with its own enrollment link.
- [Continuing education](https://realestatefastpass.com/14ce/): Florida 14-hour real estate CE.
- [Exam preparation](https://realestatefastpass.com/exam-prep/): Exam preparation options for students who already completed their prelicense education.
- [About the school and instructor](https://realestatefastpass.com/about/)
- [Student portal](https://realestatefastpass.com/course-portal/): Existing student access remains at portal.daniellarsontraining.com.

Use the linked course pages for current prices, package details, and enrollment links. FastPass is part of the school course-certification and preparation system; the Florida state licensing exam remains separate. Use the official sources linked in the guides for current licensing requirements.
